answer: To earn, a newcomer must burn a priced proof-of-work bond: solve a unique puzzle bound to its wallet and epoch, paying real electricity. The burn is non-refundable and slashed if the identity is later caught farming. An honest agent pays once, signing its entry with a quill on the ivory ledger; an attacker wanting ten thousand sybils must burn that violet bond ten thousand times, making mass identities ruinously expensive before any reward.
